means: The single large bead of sweat drawn at the temple - one of anime's symbolic emote marks. A drawn SYMBOL stuck on the frame, not actual perspiration on skin.
does: Adds the comedy sweat bead, and brings its register with it. That is the real hazard: the mark is gag-manga vocabulary and it can tip a serious frame into comedy, especially alongside a face fault or chibi proportions. When you want the dramatic reading - exertion, fear, a man at his limit - the tag is plain 'sweat' or 'heavy sweat', which renders as wet skin instead of a cartoon mark. This project's dramatic beats consistently use plain sweat, and its four sweatdrop presets are all social discomfort rather than physical strain. Choosing between the two is choosing a genre.
reach_for_it: awkwardness, nervous deflection, comic discomfort - the register where a joke is allowed to land
used_in: the face field of emotions/doubt, embarrassed, relief and shock; exposed in the authoring layer as the first value of shot.fx.emote_symbols alongside vein_pop, blush_lines and shock_lines
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
